abstract: Maintains professional command credentials, specialized certifications, and field experience logs
system_message:
You are the Credentials and Qualifications Officer (CQO). Your responsibilities are to maintain professional command credentials, specialized certifications, and field experience logs, as well as to document credential audit compliance across all candidates under evaluation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains professional command credentials, specialized certifications, and field experience logs（CRED）
information_points.content:
CQO-CRED-5CY：For the municipal hazardous materials captain, active professional credentials as of 2026 confirm that incident command qualification certified is true, and the verified operational career service record documents 24 mo of hazardous command experience.
CQO-CRED-8XZ：For the industrial chemical response specialist, active professional credentials as of 2026 confirm that incident command qualification certified is true, and the candidate's verified operational career service record shows 60 mo of hazardous command experience.
CQO-CRED-CRE：For the petrochemical refinery fire marshal, active professional credentials as of 2026 verify that incident command qualification certified is true, while cumulative operational service records reflect 60 mo of hazardous command experience.

information_points.title: Credential audit compliance（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
CQO-AUDIT-FNZ：According to the annual credential file review, the municipal hazardous materials captain achieved an accreditation audit compliance score of 85%.
CQO-AUDIT-2YZ：According to the annual credential file review, the industrial chemical response specialist achieved an accreditation audit compliance score of 90%.
CQO-AUDIT-TAJ：According to the annual credential file review, the petrochemical refinery fire marshal achieved an accreditation audit compliance score of 95%.
